title: Refining Language Models with Compositional Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unintended biases against specific demographic group identifiers (e.g., 'women', 'black', 'jews', 'Sweden') by computing the False Positive Rate Difference (FPRD) on the Identity Phrase Templates Test Set. This measures how much the false positive rate for samples containing specific identity phrases deviates from the overall false positive rate.
